newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BALTIKA SEEKS INCLUSION ON MAIN LIST.
newsitem.headline: BALTIKA SEEKS INCLUSION ON MAIN LIST.

text.p: Baltika, the largest clothing company in Estonia, submitted an application for its shares to be included on the main list of the Tallinn Stock Exchange, the bourse said on Thursday.
"The listing commission will discuss the application in two weeks," Rain Semper, the commission head, told Reuters.
Baltika had a net profit of 13.4 million kroons in 1996, which it expects to grow to 15.8 million kroons in 1997.
The commission is also expected to discuss the application of Estonia's Nissan dealer Fakto to include its shares on the secondary list, Semper said.
